name: After § 75
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 75a. Notes that almost 160 countries have become signatories to the Global Methane Pledge; calls for a quantified impact assessment on all sectors affected, including of the financial and social impact of the progress made since the adoption of the pledge at COP26;
